flora: Podocarp Conifers (tall, slender trunks, spirally arranged evergreen leaves)
environment_details.style_notes: STYLE_ANIMATED_FEATURE_V3; slender but sturdy trunk silhouettes; leaves appear as soft, overlapping clusters rather than sharp needles; tactile bark with a slightly weathered, sun-bleached texture; rounded, toy-like branch tips.

visual_logic.composition: A low-angle shot looking up at a small cluster of Podocarp Conifers. Their dark green foliage provides a stark, vertical contrast against a bright, expansive sky and the red earth of the plains.
visual_logic.ground: Dry, variegated red and ochre earth with visible mud-cracks and scattered, sun-bleached wood fragments.
visual_logic.lighting: SUNNY_EXPOSED_CINEMATIC; high-key sunlight from a high angle, creating sharp, dark shadows on the ground and highlighting the volume of the foliage.
